item.driftwrecks.driftlure.tip: Hang it on your Tension Post: a wreck drifts in soon after.
item.driftwrecks.strand_lure.tip: Hang it on your Tension Post: the wreck likely wears this Strand's skin.
item.driftwrecks.weft_key.tip: Opens a Hold's sealed rift of this Strand. Spent on use.
item.driftwrecks.salvage_bundle.tip: Right-click to unpack what the wreck was holding for you.
item.driftwrecks.wreck_map_scroll.tip: Read it: the next wreck is a place your Atlas has not seen.
item.driftwrecks.hint_page.tip: Read it to file it in the Codex for your whole Clowder.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_heartwreck.in: Nine threads, one knot. It is warm.
gui.driftwrecks.atlas.locked: Tension the %s Strand to hear from its wrecks.
gui.driftwrecks.atlas.no_perks: Finish a column or a row.
gui.driftwrecks.atlas.heart.1: The Heartwreck is drifting your way.
gui.driftwrecks.atlas.heart.3: You stood in the heart of the old world.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_soil_shrine.i: Ring it softly. The roots remember the tune.
gui.driftwrecks.place.soil_shrine: The Pad-keepers called it the Hearthbank.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_soil_watchtow: Push it in. It tells you what the ground wants.
gui.driftwrecks.place.soil_watchtower: The Pad-keepers called it the Long Furrow Post.
Every seed has a name. Most of them are lullabies.
gui.driftwrecks.place.soil_library: The Pad-keepers called it the Seedlist House.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_soil_forge.in: Sharpened so often it is mostly memory.
gui.driftwrecks.place.soil_forge: The Pad-keepers called it the Mattock Shed.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_soil_garden.i: Sealed with wax and a thumbprint. Whose, nobody knows.
gui.driftwrecks.place.soil_garden: The Pad-keepers called it the Warm Bed.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_soil_vault.in: Open it only when the ground is ready.
gui.driftwrecks.place.soil_vault: The Pad-keepers called it the Seed-Cellar.
Tap it and it sings back your name.
gui.driftwrecks.place.stone_shrine: The Grit-singers called it the Hall of Echoes.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_stone_watchto: Strike it on stone. Listen for what is hollow.
gui.driftwrecks.place.stone_watchtower: The Grit-singers called it the Listening Spire.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_stone_library: Every stone has a pitch. Write it down before you break it.
gui.driftwrecks.place.stone_library: The Grit-singers called it the Echo Register.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_stone_forge.i: It rings true only when it cuts true.
gui.driftwrecks.place.stone_forge: The Grit-singers called it the Grit Mill.
It grew one ring a year. Count them.
gui.driftwrecks.place.stone_garden: The Grit-singers called it the Moss Terraces.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_stone_vault.i: Hum the right note and the lock gives way.
gui.driftwrecks.place.stone_vault: The Grit-singers called it the Hollow Vault.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sprout_shrine: The Rootbinders called it the Anchor Grove.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_sprout_watcht: The vines grew around it while someone was looking.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sprout_watchtower: The Rootbinders called it the Canopy Lookout.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_sprout_librar: Nine flowers, one from each island. One is missing.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sprout_library: The Rootbinders called it the Leaf Archive.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sprout_forge: The Rootbinders called it the Grafting Shed.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sprout_garden: The Rootbinders called it the Nursery Terraces.
Grown shut. It opens for the patient.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sprout_vault: The Rootbinders called it the Root Cellar.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_claw_shrine.i: Four scratches: one for every edge they came back from.
gui.driftwrecks.place.claw_shrine: The Edge-walkers called it the Last Post Shrine.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_claw_watchtow: It never went out. It was only put down.
gui.driftwrecks.place.claw_watchtower: The Edge-walkers called it the Brink Watch.
Each knot a foothold. Read it with your fingers.
gui.driftwrecks.place.claw_library: The Edge-walkers called it the Route Loft.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_claw_forge.in: For ice, for rock, for the parts of the map that were never drawn.
gui.driftwrecks.place.claw_forge: The Edge-walkers called it the Claw Smithy.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_claw_garden.i: It grows only where nothing should.
gui.driftwrecks.place.claw_garden: The Edge-walkers called it the Ledge Beds.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_claw_vault.in: Worn by whoever went farthest. Pass it on.
gui.driftwrecks.place.claw_vault: The Edge-walkers called it the Far Cache.
Warm to the touch, whatever the weather.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spark_shrine: The Drumhearts called it the Pulse Circle.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spark_watchto: One long note: all is well. Three short: come home.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spark_watchtower: The Drumhearts called it the Thunder Mast.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spark_library: Beats carved in copper. Play it and you will not be alone.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spark_library: The Drumhearts called it the Measure House.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spark_forge.i: It still breathes when you hold it near a fire.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spark_forge: The Drumhearts called it the Spark Forge.
Hot enough to wake the dead. Plant with care.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spark_garden: The Drumhearts called it the Ember Gardens.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spark_vault: The Drumhearts called it the Charge Vault.
Tick. Tick. It keeps going without being told.
gui.driftwrecks.place.clock_shrine: The Pattern-weavers called it the Round Chapel.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_clock_watchto: It tells the time in a world that has stopped keeping it.
gui.driftwrecks.place.clock_watchtower: The Pattern-weavers called it the Hour Tower.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_clock_library: Page one refers to page nine. Page nine refers to page one.
gui.driftwrecks.place.clock_library: The Pattern-weavers called it the Pattern Stacks.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_clock_forge.i: Nine teeth, one missing. It still turns.
gui.driftwrecks.place.clock_forge: The Pattern-weavers called it the Gear Loft.
Wind it once a year. It will know when to open.
gui.driftwrecks.place.clock_garden: The Pattern-weavers called it the Hedge Maze.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_clock_vault.i: It opens at an hour that no longer exists.
gui.driftwrecks.place.clock_vault: The Pattern-weavers called it the Strongroom Clock.
gui.driftwrecks.place.swarm_shrine: The Colony-keepers called it the Humming Altar.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_swarm_watchto: Watch which way they fly. They know before you do.
gui.driftwrecks.place.swarm_watchtower: The Colony-keepers called it the Drone Tower.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_swarm_library: Honey accounts, forty years of them. Every jar is written down.
gui.driftwrecks.place.swarm_library: The Colony-keepers called it the Comb Archive.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_swarm_forge.i: A little smoke calms the hive. A little more calms the keeper.
gui.driftwrecks.place.swarm_forge: The Colony-keepers called it the Wax Works.
Bees will find it before you have finished planting.
gui.driftwrecks.place.swarm_garden: The Colony-keepers called it the Bloom Fields.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_swarm_vault.i: Sealed for a queen that never hatched.
gui.driftwrecks.place.swarm_vault: The Colony-keepers called it the Brood Vault.
Turn it once for a promise. Twice to keep it.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sigil_shrine: The Seal-carvers called it the Oath Stone.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_sigil_watchto: What it lights cannot cross the line.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sigil_watchtower: The Seal-carvers called it the Ward Beacon.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_sigil_library: Charcoal on paper. The seal itself is lost.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sigil_library: The Seal-carvers called it the Rune Library.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_sigil_forge.i: The point is worn to the exact width of a promise.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sigil_forge: The Seal-carvers called it the Carving Bench.
Grows a new facet every full moon.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sigil_garden: The Seal-carvers called it the Crystal Beds.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_sigil_vault.i: Whatever is inside, they wanted it kept.
gui.driftwrecks.place.sigil_vault: The Seal-carvers called it the Sealed Undercroft.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spindle_shrin: It spins even when your hand is still.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spindle_shrine: The Loom-stitchers called it the Loom Chapel.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spindle_watch: It points toward whatever needs mending.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spindle_watchtower: The Loom-stitchers called it the Gate Lookout.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spindle_libra: Pattern Card of the Old Sky
Punched holes, a shuttle's path. The whole weave of the world.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spindle_library: The Loom-stitchers called it the Thread Archive.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spindle_forge: Worn smooth by a thousand crossings.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spindle_forge: The Loom-stitchers called it the Shuttle Works.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spindle_garde: Every thread starts as a flower.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spindle_garden: The Loom-stitchers called it the Flax Field.
block.driftwrecks.keepsake_spindle_vault: Every tribe, one thread each. One is still loose.
gui.driftwrecks.place.spindle_vault: The Loom-stitchers called it the Gate Vault.

message.driftwrecks.rift.tear_sealed: The tear is sealed. A Weft Key of this wreck's Strand would open it.
message.driftwrecks.chest.still_drifting: The chest is still drifting into place.
message.driftwrecks.chest.heart_opens: The heart of the wreck gives up what it kept.
message.driftwrecks.command.no_land: No wreck could land (no clear sky, or bad arguments).
message.driftwrecks.lure.hang_on_post: Hang the lure on your Tension Post.
message.driftwrecks.lure.need_soil: Tension the Soil Strand first. Nothing drifts to a loose weave.
message.driftwrecks.lure.already_holds: Your weft already holds a wreck.
message.driftwrecks.lure.bead_not_tensio: That bead's Strand is not tensioned here.
message.driftwrecks.lure.hums: The lure hums on the post. Something out there turns toward it.
message.driftwrecks.hint_page.known: Your Clowder already knows this page. Keep it, or let it go.
message.driftwrecks.map_scroll.pending: The last map still points the way.
message.driftwrecks.map_scroll.read: The map shows a place your Atlas has not. The next wreck will be one of those.
message.driftwrecks.rift.already_walked: This rift has already been walked.
message.driftwrecks.rift.no_arena: The rift has nowhere to open (arena dimension missing).
message.driftwrecks.rift.enter: The rift folds shut behind you. Something small and frayed wears the shape of a Guardian.
message.driftwrecks.rift.fold_back: The rift folds you back in.
message.driftwrecks.rift.failed: The rift lets go of you. The Remnant stays frayed.
message.driftwrecks.rift.all_mended: Every Remnant mended. Weft Keys cost you half now.
message.driftwrecks.drift.thread_snaps: The thread snaps. You are home.
message.driftwrecks.drift.unravels: The driftwreck unravels back into the void.
message.driftwrecks.tether.wrong_level: Wrecks drift in the Skies. The spool finds nothing to catch here.
message.driftwrecks.tether.no_wreck: No wreck is caught on your weft.
message.driftwrecks.tether.face_wreck: Face the wreck, then throw the thread.
message.driftwrecks.tether.own_ground: Throw the thread from your own ground, not from the wreck.
message.driftwrecks.tether.runs_out: The thread runs out ahead of you.
message.driftwrecks.tether.catches: The thread catches you. It will not always be there.
message.driftwrecks.objective.heart_arri: You stand in the heart of the old world. It starts to slip the moment you arrive.
message.driftwrecks.objective.wrong_thre: Wrong thread. The pillars go dark—watch the idol again.
message.driftwrecks.objective.idol_quiet: The idol is quiet. This wreck asks something else of you.
message.driftwrecks.objective.spawners_q: The last frayed spawner goes quiet.
message.driftwrecks.objective.echo_saved: The echo steps onto your pad and settles, purring. Thank you, it seems to say.
message.driftwrecks.objective.echo_fades: The echo fades. The chests are still yours.
message.driftwrecks.objective.seam_holds: The seam holds. The wreck will stay a while longer.
message.driftwrecks.rewards.heart_lore: The Skies were never an ending. They were the Loom, holding its breath.
message.driftwrecks.rewards.heart_done: The Heartwreck lets go. Keep what it gave you—and go on weaving.
message.driftwrecks.rewards.heart_broadc: A Clowder stood in the heart of the old world:
message.driftwrecks.rewards.atlas_page: A page of the Wreck Atlas fills in:
message.driftwrecks.rewards.atlas_comple: Every page answers. Somewhere under the Skies, the heart of the old world starts to drift your way.
message.driftwrecks.rewards.all_stamps: All six stamps. Your wrecks hold a quarter longer.
message.driftwrecks.command.already_has: Your Clowder already has wreck #%s. /driftwreck unravel %s
message.driftwrecks.lure.settling_one: The weft is still settling. Try again in %s minute.
message.driftwrecks.lure.settling_many: The weft is still settling. Try again in %s minutes.
message.driftwrecks.hint_page.filed: A page about the old %s is filed in the Codex.
message.driftwrecks.rift.wrong_key: The key is cut for another Strand. This rift wants %s.
message.driftwrecks.rift.mended: The Remnant comes apart into clean thread. The %s would have called that mending.
message.driftwrecks.drift.arrival_heart_: Every tribe's thread pulls the same way at once. Something enormous is caught on your weft.
message.driftwrecks.drift.arrival_line: Something old is caught on your weft. It will not hold for long—go.
message.driftwrecks.drift.warn_95: Let go, or be taken with it.
message.driftwrecks.tether.too_far: Too far. A spool holds %s blocks of thread.
message.driftwrecks.objective.heart_pill: Nine threads, one weave. The heart holds its breath.
message.driftwrecks.objective.pillars_do: The pillars sing in order. The seam steadies.
message.driftwrecks.rewards.column_whole: The %s column is whole. %s lures cost half, their wrecks come oftener, and their banner is yours to weave.
message.driftwrecks.rewards.row_whole: Every tribe's %s is in the Atlas. Their hidden rooms will always open for you.
message.driftwrecks.remnant.soil_buries: It buries itself. A root-seam glows—dig.
message.driftwrecks.remnant.soil_exposed: The root core breaks. It is exposed!
message.driftwrecks.remnant.stone_grit: Grit falls from the seam. Feed it to the maw.
message.driftwrecks.remnant.clock_opens: The pattern holds. The chassis opens!
message.driftwrecks.remnant.clock_wrong: Out of pattern. The gears bite.
message.driftwrecks.remnant.swarm_cells: Drone cells knit into the walls. Break them.
message.driftwrecks.remnant.swarm_bare: The last cell falls. The queen is bare!
message.driftwrecks.remnant.sigil_expose: The last ward breaks. It stands exposed!
